doc.name: Legwork success table (template)
doc.description:
Target Number: 4 — change the number to the adventure's, if it gives one.

Copy this table into the world for each mystery (right-click → Import, or drag it to the Rollable Tables tab), rename it, and write what the runners learn at each success count. Rows are cumulative: a runner who rolls 3 successes learns rows 1, 2 and 3 (SR3 p.253). Each row's range is the success count that reveals it; add a 0 row for what a failure turns up, or a 4 and 5 row for more, by editing the ranges.

The 🔎 Legwork tool on the Rollable Tables tab rolls the test and shows the rows reached, with the contact's fee (SR3 p.253-254).
